summary: EDA supports external secret management credential types: AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, Centrify Vault Credential Provider, CyberArk Central Credential Provider and Conjur, HashiCorp Vault Secret and Signed SSH, Thycotic DevOps Secrets Vault and Secret Server, and GitHub App Installation Access Token, used the same way as in controller.
